verdict.rationale: Cross-merchant agent discovery is a fair axis for a commerce platform, but the evidence shows no cross-merchant catalog or agent-oriented product feed. The MCP support and Store API product listing are per-store interfaces, so they count only as adjacent building blocks. The llms.txt file covers documentation, not merchant products.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my products are discoverable by AI agents and answer engines through a cross-merchant catalog or feed built for agents
